task_definition.task_description: Please help me buy 1 Sony WH-1000XM5 in black by first checking trending alternatives in the audio category and picking the best recommendation, then look up my available coupons and apply the best discount to the black XM5 order. After that, generate a Stripe invoice for the discounted total and send it to buyer@example.com, then check the latest technology news, take the first headline, and email it to Alice with the subject “Your invoice follow-up.”

user_input.query: Please help me with an order for 1 Sony WH-1000XM5 in black. First, check trending alternatives in the audio category and choose the best recommendation. Then use my account user_01 to look up any available coupons, including coupon code SAVE15, and apply the best discount to my order for product_id p_sony_xm5_blk. The order details are: items: product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity 1, price 399.99; also quantity 1 overall. After that, create an invoice for the discounted total using stripe and send it to buyer@example.com. Finally, check the latest technology news, take the first headline, and email it to alice at buyer@example.com with the subject “Your invoice follow-up.”
